title: Require every text-grammar shape in a brief's Hardening answer
body: Outcome: `krn brief check` refuses a text-grammar answer that is not N/A and does not name each shape the checklist lists (repeated sections, fenced code, 0-3 space indent, CRLF, BOM, control characters) as handled or as a non-goal. t-mmh9ff6 review attempt 1 blocked on indented index rows silently skipped, a shape the checklist names but the brief omitted. Proof: a brief-check test red on a text-grammar answer naming only CRLF and BOM.
